title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 13.2 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 13.2 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 allowed an authenticated user with owner-role permissions to execute arbitrary JavaScript in another user's browser via the Confluence integration due to improper input validation. This cross-site scripting (XSS) flaw could lead to partial confidentiality and integrity impacts but does not affect availability.
